sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

To support the price in our term sheet:
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
We placed our last 3 orders for this part at EUR 5.84 per unit (po:4500014427-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014292-10).
Your on-time delivery averaged 82.5% over the last 4 quarters (sc:70740@2026Q3, sc:70740@2026Q2, sc:70740@2026Q1, sc:70740@2025Q4).

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We are willing to build on your second term sheet, adopting the 24-month contract and the AS-14404 index clause to jointly manage material risks.
In exchange for these terms, we can offer a revised price of €5.70 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
